candidates.event: The White House removes some Canadian goods from its 50% tariff list and adds others, effective 30 October

facts.claim: The White House announced on Friday 23 October that from 30 October some Canadian products (plywood, some paper products, certain machinery, refrigeration equipment) leave the tariff list while others (valves, carpets, waste products) are added
facts.quote: replacing those products with certain valves, carpets, waste products, and others

facts.claim: The changes take effect 30 October, four days before the US election on 3 November
facts.quote: will take effect Oct. 30, four days before the Nov. 3 U.S. election

facts.claim: The US imposed a 50% levy on about 20 billion dollars of Canadian goods after trade talks collapsed in August
facts.quote: The US imposed a 50% levy on $20bn (£15bn) worth of Canadian goods after trade talks between the two countries collapsed in August.

facts.claim: Canada says it is assessing the steps and stands ready to work towards a trading relationship; Canada has imposed countermeasures
facts.quote: While we assess these latest steps, Canada stands ready to work constructively and in good faith

candidates.conflicts: BBC says tariffs are eased on some goods; CNBC and the White House fact sheet say removed products are replaced by others (net change, not a cut). Guardian says exemptions cover nine agricultural product categories per Sen. Collins (s210); BBC and CNBC list industrial goods.
candidates.notes: Political context (Collins re-election race) is in the sources and must stay out of the item. Official White House proclamation reported by three outlets.

candidates.event: Moody's keeps France's Aa3 rating with a negative outlook; French 10-year yield at its highest since 2002

facts.claim: Moody's on Friday kept France's Aa3 credit rating and its negative outlook, citing political fragmentation impairing the legislature
facts.quote: Rating agency Moody's on Friday kept its Aa3 credit rating on France

facts.claim: The 10-year French yield rose 11 basis points on Thursday to its highest level since 2002
facts.quote: climbed 11 basis points Thursday to its highest level since 2002

facts.claim: Government aims to cut the deficit to 5% of GDP in 2027 from a projected 5.4% in 2026; the National Assembly resumes debate on the budget's tax measures on 27 October
facts.quote: The National Assembly is due to resume debating on the budget's tax measures, which are intended to generate savings, on Oct. 27

candidates.notes: Single outlet in the bundle, but rating action is an official act and the yield is a published figure. Unrest/protest context stays out of the item.

candidates.event: Super Power acquires the household-electricity customer portfolio of Paz Gas Energy, the first merger in Israel's private electricity supply market

facts.claim: Super Power announced to the stock exchange that it is buying competitor Paz Gas Energy, cutting the number of household electricity suppliers from seven to six
facts.quote: ספקית החשמל הביתי סופר פאוור רוכשת את המתחרה פז גז אנרג'י, ובכך מצטמצם מספר המתחרות בתחום משבע לשש בלבד

facts.claim: Payment up to 25 million shekels; expected added annual revenue about 130 million shekels
facts.quote: תשלם תמורת הרכישה עד 25 מיליון שקל

facts.claim: About 450 thousand households have already moved to private electricity suppliers
facts.quote: כיום, כ־450 אלף משקי בית כבר עברו לספקי חשמל פרטיים

candidates.conflicts: Globes gives payment as up to 25 million shekels and also 23-25 million shekels in the body; the first stage is 15 million plus 8-10 million.
candidates.notes: Source is a company filing reported by Globes only. Borderline on impact; may need approval of the Competition Authority (not stated in the text I read).

candidates.event: Dalia Energy files for international arbitration in London over the cancelled Leviathan gas deal with NewMed and Ratio

facts.claim: Dalia filed a request to open arbitration at the London Court of International Arbitration against NewMed Energy and Ratio
facts.quote: דליה הגישה אתמול בקשה לפתיחת הליך בוררות בבית הדין הבינלאומי לבוררות בלונדון (LCIA)

facts.claim: The deal is a 20-year gas supply from 2030 to 2050 at 4.7 dollars per heat unit, signed in May; the sellers announced its cancellation on 24 September citing unmet conditions
facts.quote: מדובר בהתקשרות ל-20 שנה, מ-2030 ועד 2050, במחיר של 4.7 דולר ליחידת חום

candidates.conflicts: The parties dispute whether the deal was validly cancelled; Dalia claims Competition Authority approval came within the agreed timeframe.
candidates.notes: A filing by one party in a formal proceeding; describe only as filed, not the merits. Borderline durability.

candidates.event: Volvo Cars to cut 2,500 jobs after a third-quarter operating loss

facts.claim: Volvo Cars announced a plan to cut 2,500 jobs after a decline in its Chinese market hit third-quarter results
facts.quote: Volvo Cars said Friday it plans to cut 2,500 jobs after a sharp decline in its Chinese market weighed on third-quarter earnings.

facts.claim: Operating loss of 5.6 billion Swedish kronor in the quarter, versus an operating profit of 6.4 billion in the previous period; China revenues fell almost 50% year on year
facts.quote: reported an operating loss of 5.6 billion Swedish kronor ($563.7 million) in the third quarter

candidates.notes: Company results; foreign, limited relevance to Israeli readers. Low-to-medium impact.

candidates.event: Brent crude passes 117 dollars a barrel, the highest since April

facts.claim: Brent rose about 3.5% on Friday to pass 117 dollars at one point, the highest since April; it was about 72 dollars in February before the Iran war
facts.quote: Brent crude, the international benchmark for oil, rose by about 3.5% on Friday to pass $117 a barrel at one point

facts.claim: Globes: Brent 117.10 dollars and WTI 102.98 dollars at the Friday close in Wall Street trading
facts.quote: WTI עלה ל-102.98 דולר וברנט ל-117.10 דולר

candidates.conflicts: Guardian says the price later eased to just over 116 dollars.
candidates.notes: A market move, not a decision; attribution of the cause is analyst speculation (excluded). Include only as a measured price level if the editor wants it. Low durability.
